title: Velvety Sour Spanish Chicken Paella
description: A comforting Spanish dish featuring grand marnier and sashimi-cut chicken, perfect for a weeknight dinner. Sour and velvety, this low-fat-friendly paella is a twist on the classic Spanish recipe.

ingredients.name: Rice
ingredients.notes: Spanish short-grain rice, such as Bomba or Calasparra

instructions: Heat the oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the white wine and vegetable broth, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Add the saffron threads and their soaking liquid, smoked paprika, and tomato paste. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the rice and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
While the rice is cooking, prepare the velvety sauce by whisking together the egg yolks and Grand Marnier in a small bowl.
When the rice is cooked, stir in the velvety sauce and cook for 1-2 minutes, until heated through.
Serve the paella hot, garnished with lemon wedges and fresh herbs, if desired.
